check: Action Atlas showcase replayed twice from a clean SQLite store as the app-UI adapter; both replays share one fingerprint
limitations: Fixture path: the replay drives OperationService on original fixtures. It proves the domain contract on this build, not a device, a system surface, an entry point other than the runner's adapter, or a UI.
The App Intents and the in-app action browser: the replay submits each change to OperationService as the adapter it is composed with, and never runs an intent type or the Action Atlas action library.
The system's confirmation and disambiguation dialogs: an approve step stands in for the person's confirmation.
Host views and the receipt inspector: the replay renders nothing.
Imported user data: the person's collection and item here are created by operations, not adopted from staging.
Shortcuts, Siri, physical devices, and the iOS, watchOS, and tvOS simulators: the replay runs in the package test process on the Mac.

outcome.detail: 19 of 19 steps passed. Replay fingerprint sha256:4e814ad8dc3e5eab14d0fc86176847e1e9b5194be235675181e0b16eb230cc4b. Adapter app-ui; store sqlite (schema 2, temporary file); timebase swift-continuous-clock.

steps: approve-reset: The person confirms Reset Demo.
reset: Reset Demo creates the 12 original samples: 3 collections and 12 items in the demo namespace.
create-collection: Create one of the person's own collections, with the ID Create Lab Collection derives from this request ID.
create-item: Create an item in that collection, with the ID Create Lab Item derives from this request ID.
find-graphite: Find the new item by text.
find-swatches: List the Pigment swatches demo collection, ordered by title.
update-item: Rewrite the new item's note at revision 1.
update-sample: Rename the amber demo sample at revision 1. It stays in the demo namespace.
find-renamed: Find the renamed sample by its new title, ignoring case.
approve-archive: The person confirms archiving the new item.
archive-item: Archive the new item at revision 2.
find-after-archive: The archived item no longer appears in a search.
find-archived: It is still there when archived items are included: archiving deletes nothing.
undo-archive: Undo the archive with the operation its receipt recorded.
find-after-undo: The restored item appears in a search again.
approve-reset-again: The person confirms Reset Demo a second time.
reset-again: Reset Demo restores the renamed sample and leaves the person's own collection and item alone.
find-after-reset: The sample's edit is gone: it has its seed title again.
find-yours-after-reset: The person's item is untouched, note and all.
